paragraphs.text: DSH的用量统计插件，也可统计DSH调用的其他模型的总量。
# dsh-tok-qty

> 输入框状态栏上的 DeepSeek 余额 + token 用量统计。
> DeepSeek balance and token-usage stats in the DSH composer st

的 DeepSeek 余额 + token 用量统计。
> DeepSeek balance and token-usage stats in the DSH composer status bar.
中文
## 能做什么
输入框右下角那排状态信息里,多一个钱包图标和你的**总余额**(如 `总余额 ¥31.99`)。点它展开一块面板:

- **今日 / 本周 / 本月**切换,总量跟着标签走
- 面板顶部是当前范围的**总量**(只统计 DeepSeek 的调用)
- **分时段面积图**:今天按 24 小时分桶,本周按 7 天,本

月按当月每天;鼠标移上去有竖线、圆点和该时段的数值浮签
- **横向柱状图**:同一时间段里,本地模型和其他厂商(Anthropic、OpenAI、OpenRouter……)各用了多少,一眼看出 De

epSeek 占多大比例
- 明细行:缓存读取 / 未缓存输入 / 输出 / 缓存命中率
- 右上角**刷新**按钮即时重算,旁边的**齿轮**打开设置:面积图峰谷两色可用拾色盘拖拽选取、柱状图每个分
组单独配色、五类字段逐个显示或隐藏,底部「恢复默认」一键还原
设置存在浏览器 localStorage 里,关掉面板再打开回到统计界面,不会又跳进设置。
**数据从哪来**:余额走 DeepSeek 官方 `GET /user/balance`;用量读本机里的 `assistant/message` 事件。全部在本机算,**不上传任何东西**,浏览器侧
也永远看不到 API key(由宿主进程代发请求)。
**余额怎么读到 key**:依次尝试 DSH 的凭据服务 → `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 。所以只要 DSH 本身能用 DeepSeek,这里就能显示余额。
## 安装
[代码示例省略，未执行]
装完重启 DSH。插件自带 bundle patch,不需要再改 `cordis.patch.yml`。
## 兼容性

- 需要能在 `conversation.composer.dock` 注册的 DSH 客户端(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`)
- 用量统计依赖多
帧 zstd 解压(Node 20+ 的 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`;旧版本 Node 会退化成只读到第一帧,面板显示 0)
## 已知边界

- dock 只在已有会话里渲染,新建会话的欢迎页没有这个药丸
- 「其他模型」的分组只按 provider 前缀判断:能认出 WorkBuddy、本地模型(lm-*/omlx/local)和常见厂商

,认不出的归到「其他」
- 只统计会话日志里写下来的调用;在 DSH 之外用同一个 API key 花的钱不进这个统计(余额本身是全账户的)
English
## What it does
A wallet icon and your **total balance** (e.g. `总余额 ¥31.99`) join the status row at the bottom right
of the composer. Click it to open a panel with:

- **Today / This week / This month** tabs — the headline total follows the selected tab
- The **tota

l for the selected range** at the top of the panel (DeepSeek calls only)
- An **area chart over time
**: 24 hourly buckets for today, 7 days for this week, one bucket per day for this month; hovering s

hows a vertical guide, a dot and a tooltip with that bucket's value
- A **horizontal bar chart**: ho
w much the local models and the other vendors (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, …) used over that same

period, so you can see at a glance what share DeepSeek takes
- Detail rows: cache reads, uncached i

nput, output, cache-hit rate
- A **refresh** button in the top right recomputes on the spot; the **g
ear** beside it opens settings: drag a picker to choose the area chart's peak and valley colours, co
lour each bar group separately, show or hide each of the five items, and restore everything with **r
eset to defaults** at the bottom
Settings live in the browser's `localStorage`; close the panel and open it again and you are back on
the stats view, never dropped into settings.
**Where the numbers come from**: the balance comes from DeepSeek's official `GET /user/balance`; usa
ge comes from the `assistant/message` events in the session logs on this machine. Everything is comp
uted locally, **nothing is uploaded**, and the browser never sees the API key — the host process sen
ds the request on its behalf.
**How the key is found**: the DSH credential service first, then `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. So as long as D
SH itself can use DeepSeek, a balance shows up here.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH afterwards. The package ships its own bundle patch, so there is nothing to edit in `cord
terwards. The package ships its own bundle patch, so there is nothing to edit in `cordis.patch.yml`.
## Compatibility
- A DSH client that can register into `conversation.composer.dock` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conv

ersation`)
- Usage stats rely on multi-frame zstd decompression (`zlib.zstdDecompressSync`, Node 20+
; on older Node builds only the first frame is read and the panel shows 0)
## Known limits
- The dock only renders inside an existing session; the welcome screen of a new session has no pill
- Bar grouping is decided by provider prefix: WorkBuddy, local models (`lm-*`, `omlx`, `local`) and

the common vendors are recognised, anything else lands in "Other"
- Only calls written to the sessio
n logs are counted; spending with the same API key outside DSH never enters these numbers (the balan
ce itself is account-wide)

evidence.fact: 已知边界称用量统计只涵盖会话日志记录的调用，DSH 外使用同一 API key 的支出不计入用量统计。

limitations: 用量不涵盖 DSH 外的调用；README 称余额为全账户余额。
